﻿subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the editing task: one continuous ~9.4 s vertical indoor dance take of two young women dancing together in a bright hallway/room with beige walls and wood floor (Douyin watermark may appear).
<Picture 1> is a character reference of the left dancer's replacement for [Shot 1]: silver-ash bob with cyan tips in a dark forest-green satin gown (green dress sheet).
<Picture 2> is a character reference of the right dancer's replacement for [Shot 1]: the same silver-blue short-haired woman in a white outfit/suit sheet.
<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1> (green gown), replacing the left dancer (blue-white striped shirt, white lace skirt, black bow) in <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> is the woman in <Picture 2> (white outfit), replacing the right dancer (black tube top, black track pants) in <Video 1>.

summary:
[video editing + character replacement] Both dancers in <Video 1> become <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> exactly as in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, keeping motion, timing, camera and room of <Video 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (source video editing): fully_preserved - shot continuity, camera, room, dance motion and timing are copied frame for frame.
<Picture 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): reference - green gown identity for the left figure.
<Picture 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): reference - white-outfit identity for the right figure.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved as green-gown look.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved as white-outfit look.

detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic vertical indoor dance clip.
[Shot 1] From 00:00.000 to about 00:09.400, <Subject 1> (left) and <Subject 2> (right) perform the same dance interaction as the two women in <Video 1>. In every frame the original two dancers are these two reference characters; room and camera stay as in <Video 1>.

overall_soundscape:
The source soundtrack of <Video 1> continues unchanged.
